2022 VC/Redist/MSVC directory, in accordance with the Visual Studio license.
Copyright Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.

https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/vs2022-ga-diagnosticbuildtools/

FFmpeg runtime (downloaded separately on first launch)
This ZIP does not include FFmpeg binaries. The first-run helper downloads the
unchanged LGPL shared runtime from BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds and verifies SHA-256 before
extracting DLLs. Its original license is retained as runtime/LICENSE.txt.
Build: ffmpeg-n7.1.5-12-g1fdbca85aa-win64-lgpl-shared-7.1
Publisher archive:
https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/autobuild-2026-07-31-14-10/ffmpeg-n7.1.5-12-g1fdbca85aa-win64-lgpl-shared-7.1.zip
SHA256: 0f376f96fb38554ccefb1b2ae9c7c6a7b351f0e60a372b38262c320e8392c5d0
Build scripts and configuration: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
FFmpeg source: https://git.ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.git
License information: https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html

Apple Devices and iloader are installed separately from their publishers.
No Apple credentials, provisioning profiles or signing certificates are
included in this distribution. Every iPad user signs with their own account.
